name: Find the Penguins 🐧
desc:
🐧 Welcome to Find The Penguins Search through the map and collect cute penguins!

🎮 How To Play:
🔎 Explore the maps to find all of the hidden penguins
🏆 Find all penguins the fastest for a spot on the leaderboard

🤝 Find penguins with friends and meet new friends along the way!
🎒 Equip the penguins you collect!
📜 What's new? – A Cave biome has cracked open along the side of the map, with tunnels stretching underground! 16 new penguins are tucked away among ores, shadows, and secrets.
